test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If sinA = (4)/(5), then find the value of (2 + tanA)(4 + cosA)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Pythagorean triplet** for sin A = 4/5 → (3, 4, 5).

Here, **Perpendicular (P)** = 4, **Hypotenuse (H)** = 5, and **Base (B)** = 3.

Calculate required ratios: tan A = P/B = 4/3 and cos A = B/H = 3/5.

Substitute in expression: (2 + 4/3) × (4 + 3/5) = (10/3) × (23/5) = 46/3.

**∴ The correct answer is 46/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin A = 4/5

**Formula Used:** sin A = P/H, cos A = B/H, tan A = P/B, where B = √(H² − P²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac519348c649e3992f1318ebc095cf6dd689007f204c22f91a9190560f8c525b.png] 

⇒ B = √(5² − 4²) = √(25 − 16) = √9 = 3

⇒ tan A = 4/3

⇒ cos A = 3/5

⇒ Value = (2 + tan A)(4 + cos A)

⇒ Value = (2 + 4/3) × (4 + 3/5)

⇒ Value = (10/3) × (23/5)

⇒ Value = 230/15 = 46/3

**∴ The correct answer is 46/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental relations include sin²A + cos²A = 1 and tan A = sin A / cos A.

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Frequently used sets in exams: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), and (8, 15, 17).</p
